name: Lotwil Veriatus
summary: East of Kargath, Lotwil Veriatus pursues dangerous experiments with the Badlands' elementals. The gnomish scholar works with his sarcastic apprentice Lucien Tosselwrench and mechanical attendant Servo, hoping to unite arcane theory, alchemy, and engineering.

sections.title: A Unified Field of Chaos
sections.body:
From Kharanos in Dun Morogh, Lotwil dreams of founding a grand University for his Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy, and Engineering Sciences. He believes arcane study, alchemy, and engineering belong together, not in separate pursuits. So he came to the harsh Badlands to study its native rock elementals and make shackles that bind elemental forces.

Lotwil has studied elemental machines and defeated dark iron constructs. Yet his mind stays so fixed on the work that he often misses the explosive danger of his experiments.

sections.title: The Elemental Shackles
sections.body: In the Badlands, Lotwil puts his shackles of elemental binding to the test. He sends adventurers to gather rock elemental cores, coolant, and gyrochronatoms for a ritual to subdue an elemental servant. When he activates the device, volatile magic, erratic engineering, and unstable alchemical reagents meet in disaster. A towering, enraged elemental monstrosity named Fam'retor appears and turns on its creator.

faq.answer: Lotwil Veriatus is a gnomish scholar at an isolated camp east of Kargath in the Badlands. A founding member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy, and Engineering Sciences, he seeks to unite all three fields in one discipline.

faq.q: Why is Lotwil out in the Badlands?
faq.answer: Lotwil came to the Badlands to study its many wild rock elementals. The open desert gives him raw elemental material and room for volatile binding experiments away from major population centers.

Lucien Tosselwrench is Lotwil's gnomish assistant. Cynical and weary of his master's eccentric ramblings, he handles logistics, repairs Servo, and warns bystanders about Lotwil's dangerous carelessness.

faq.q: What happens when Lotwil finishes his experiment?
faq.answer: Lotwil tries to enslave an elemental construct with his custom shackles of elemental binding. The device fails spectacularly and summons Fam'retor, an enormous, enraged rock elemental that must be slain before it destroys Lotwil's camp.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see intellectual ambition pushed to reckless extremes in Lotwil's attempt to unite engineering and the arcane, whatever the risks.
As an engineer, you may recognize Lotwil's effort to join mechanical gyros and gears with arcane containment fields. His work shows how suddenly engineering can fail with violent force.
